sections.heading: The details
sections.text: Everything that comes with this experience, and what to plan for yourself.

sections.heading: Highlights
sections.text:
- • Exit at 13,000 ft with the Gulf of Thailand on the horizon
- • Around sixty seconds of freefall, then five to seven minutes under canopy along the coast
- • No experience needed: your USPA-certified instructor flies the jump
- • Same aircraft, altitude and instructors in every package

sections.heading: Sea View Tandem Skydive - Pattaya
sections.text: - • A tandem skydiving experience over Pattaya with ocean views. Guests receive a safety briefing, fly to jump altitude, complete the tandem jump with a certified instructor, and choose from ECO, Deluxe, or VIP package options depending on the media coverage they want.
